preparedMetadata.variable: Warm CPU-source DataTexture aliases a complete dirty row band with full-width stride, source y rebased to zero and original destination x/y; physical rectangle bytes, public-copy count, complete GPU scratch domain and original mip generation/copy remain unchanged.
preparedMetadata.scope: Preparation provenance only; CPU mock is not native GPU sRGB mip proof or a performance result.
preparedMetadata.modelLimits: All modeled RGBA mip bytes are checked using deterministic integer-box arithmetic, not native GPU sRGB filtering. Failure injection occurs after modeled public copy completion, not between internal Three UNPACK setup/restoration; context lifecycle is modeled dispose/recreate, not real context loss.

settings.readback: Raw encoded RGBA8 GPU storage, each array layer and every native mip, via test-only framebufferTextureLayer/readPixels. No shader color decode/re-encode or alpha masking. Full-domain DataArrayTexture generateMipmap is the independent oracle.
settings.fixture: Zero first input; gradients, thin lines, nonzero RGB at alpha 0; shifted marks, transparent RGB mutation, exact repeated input, full zero clearing, full dirty union, all mip compaction; bottom-right transparent RGB, seven-row band and full-height column.
settings.timing: Correctness only; instrumentation and synchronous GPU readback deliberately exclude this script from performance comparisons.
